title: Waiting for restocks during order reservation
name: Restock reservation waiter

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code manages the lifetime of objects it registers or allocates per reservation? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A SKU is out of stock and three reservations for it are waiting. A restock adds enough units for exactly one of them, and notifyRestock is called once. What happens?
choices: All three listeners run; each tries repo.decrement, one succeeds and resolves, the other two keep waiting
Only the first listener registered runs, because emit stops after the first handler that resolves
All three reservations resolve, because the restock event is broadcast to every waiter
None resolve until the next call to reserve() for that SKU

questions.prompt: Why does the constructor call this.events.setMaxListeners(0)?
choices: It removes the default 10-listener warning so many concurrent waiters on one SKU do not log MaxListenersExceededWarning
It limits each channel to a single listener
It causes listeners to be removed automatically after they fire once

questions.prompt: In OrderReservationService.reserveOrder, an order has lines A and B. A is reserved immediately; B waits and then fails with StockUnavailableError. What is the state afterwards?
choices: Both A and B are decremented and the order is marked reserved
Neither line is decremented because reserveOrder runs in a transaction
A's stock remains decremented, B is not, and the order is marked backordered on B
The StockUnavailableError propagates to the caller and the order is not updated
